snapshot.name: Bharti Airtel Ltd
snapshot.about: Bharti Airtel Ltd is one of the world’s leading providers of telecommunication services with presence in 18 countries representing India, Sri Lanka, 14 countries in Africa. [1]

latest_quarter.source: screener quarterly table (standardised from exchange filing)
latest_quarter.headline: Revenue +17% YoY, EBITDA +18%, PAT +24%, margin 57.4% (+0.7pp YoY)

notes.text: Margins expanding: OPM 55% vs 49% avg of prior years
Profit outgrowing revenue: PAT CAGR 40% vs revenue 15% (3y)
5-yr cumulative CFO is 4.18× PAT (₹419,802 Cr vs ₹100,454 Cr)
5-yr free cash flow ₹242,514 Cr; negative in 0 of 5 years

business_mix.what_it_does: Bharti Airtel Limited is a telecommunications and digital services company providing mobile, homes, digital TV, business, and financial services across India and Africa.
business_mix.source: Bharti Airtel Limited and Bharti Hexacom Limited Q2 ended September 30, 2026 Earnings Webinar Transcript

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Margins may trend slightly downwards over the longer term.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: OPM has remained stable at 57.0 percent across Mar 2026, Jun 2026, and Sep 2026 quarters.

promises.credibility: Management guidance is largely focused on long term strategic capacity targets in data centers which remain pending.

bull: Revenue grew 17% YoY and PAT rose 24% with a 57.4% margin in the latest quarter Sep 2026.
Debt to equity improved significantly to 1.26 compared to 2.63 three periods ago.
Five-year cumulative cash flow from operations reached 4.18x PAT totaling ₹419,802 Cr versus ₹100,454 Cr.
bear: Guidance from Aug 2026 indicates that EBITDA margins may trend slightly downwards over the longer term.
Data center capacity guidance to build a one gigawatt portfolio remains pending.
Guidance to attain about 25% share in the overall Data Center market from Feb 2026 is still pending.
